intro: Timeless finished 2nd in OWCS North America, qualified for the Esports World Cup, won a FACEIT League title from 0–3 down and won Calling All Heroes twice. The players and staff did that. Three people owned the org and kept it running, with no formal titles. This page says who they are and what each one did.

people.name: Chase
people.summary: Chase co-founded Timeless in October 2022 and ran its social media. He went with the roster to NTMR as director in 2024 and came back as an owner for 2025. He now runs social for LuneX Gaming and the US World Cup team.

people.name: Jacob "Doc" Scott
people.summary: Doc handled operations. He advised NTMR during its 2024 run and was a Timeless owner for the 2025 season.

people.name: Alex "th3mfg" Scholtes
people.summary: Alex co-founded Timeless with Chase in October 2022, after Hour Zero and Kaizen. He paid for it, brought ideas and was always there. In 2024 he voted to go to Riyadh; most of the owners and staff chose not to.
